decision: Preserve the result as a two-family partial dynamic negative and do not weaken the progress, robustness, or two-per-direction gates. The only observed failing causal channel is progress at one lateral reset endpoint for one family in each direction. Freeze one bounded stroke-only static successor across the complete four-family low-contact set: 66 mm, derived prospectively as the existing 60 mm stroke plus the full 6 mm span of the already-frozen plus/minus 3 mm reset uncertainty. Keep contact height, wrist orientation, precontact path, jaw target, reset layout, physics, action rate, and all gates unchanged. No dynamic replay is authorized until all four successor actions pass the static geometry, collision, camera, and gateway checks and are frozen exactly.
